# Activity videos, and what is still generated by code

## 1. Activity video prompts (Veo 3.1 Lite / Omni 1.1)

**How it works.** The 12 activity clips (training, drilling techniques, meditation, fishing, gathering herbs, mining, hunting, cooking, music, chess, visiting, rest) currently show the painted hero doing a code animation (bob, lean). A static painting cannot swing a sword, so these are better as short videos.

**Use image-to-video.** For each clip, upload the matching first frame from `art_src/video_firstframes/<clip>_<m|f>.png` (24 images: the painted hero standing in the clip's painted background; use `_m` for the male hero and `_f` for the female hero). The prompt then only has to describe the motion. That keeps the hero and the background identical to the game art.

**Settings for every clip**
- Aspect 9:16 (portrait, same as the backgrounds), 3 seconds (2 to 4 is fine), 720p is enough, **no audio** (the game has its own).
- Static camera, no cuts, no zoom, no text, no logos, no subtitles.
- Keep the same face, outfit, backpack and sword as the first frame. Keep the painted storybook look: hand-painted ink outlines, soft watercolour, no photorealism, no 3D render look.
- Generate the male and female versions with the same prompt (only the first frame changes). If you want to save credits, do the first four (training, technique_practice, meditation, rest) for both heroes and the rest later.

**Shared prefix (put this at the start of every prompt):**
> Hand-painted Chinese ink-and-watercolour storybook animation in the style of the supplied image. Static camera, no cuts, no zoom. The character stays exactly as drawn (same face, hair, clothes, backpack, sword). Gentle painterly motion, 12 fps feel, soft ink outlines kept stable. No text, no logos, no subtitles, no audio.

**Per-clip action text (append after the prefix):**

1. **training** (valley day): The hero plants his feet, then practises fist-and-palm exercises: three slow punches forward, a low horse stance, then a deep breath. Small dust puffs at the feet. Ends smiling with both fists raised in a short triumphant pose.
2. **technique_practice** (valley dawn): The hero draws the sword and performs a short flowing sword form: one slash from right to left, a step forward, a thrust, a spin, then sheathes the sword. A faint white arc of motion follows each slash. Ends with a satisfied nod.
3. **meditation** (moonlit shrine): The hero sits cross-legged on the stone path, hands resting on the knees, eyes closed. Slow breathing; a few fireflies drift upward and a faint pale-gold glow gathers around the chest. Ends opening the eyes with a calm smile.
4. **fishing** (riverside): The hero stands at the water's edge with a bamboo fishing rod (add the rod naturally), casts the line with a smooth overhead flick, waits with small bobbing of the float, then a fish tugs; he pulls up a silver fish with a splash. Ends holding the fish up, happy.
5. **herb_gathering** (riverside bank): The hero walks a few steps, kneels, picks green herbs from the grass into a small basket, stands and shows a handful of herbs, smiling.
6. **mining** (cave mouth at night): The hero swings a small pickaxe at the rock wall beside the cave mouth three times; sparks and stone chips fly; a glowing green jade chip falls out and he catches it, delighted.
7. **hunting** (valley dawn): The hero moves quietly through tall grass in a crouch, stops, holds a hand up to listen, then leaps forward in one quick movement; a startled pheasant bursts out of the grass. Ends standing up with a satisfied grin.
8. **cooking** (village dusk): The hero tends a small clay stove with a steaming pot, stirs it with a wooden ladle, tastes it, makes a happy face, and laughs. Warm light and soft steam rise.
9. **music** (village dusk): The hero sits on a low stone, lifts a bamboo flute to the lips and plays; small musical notes made of ink brush strokes float up and fade. Ends with a small bow.
10. **chess** (village dusk): The hero sits at a low stone table with a weiqi board, places a black stone, thinks with a hand on the chin, places another, then smiles and raises a fist in triumph.
11. **social_visit** (market street): The hero walks forward a few steps, stops, bows politely with hands clasped, then waves and laughs as if greeting a neighbour just out of frame.
12. **rest** (village dusk): The hero sits down on the ground and leans on the backpack, stretches his arms, yawns, then relaxes with a content smile as a soft evening breeze moves the grass.

**Negative prompt (if the tool has the field):** photorealistic, 3D render, extra people, extra limbs, changed face, changed clothes, text, watermark, camera movement, flicker, morphing background.

**When the videos arrive.** Send me the files (mp4). I convert them to Ogg Theora (the only video format Godot Web plays), about 400 px wide, small files (a few hundred KB each), and play them in the activity clip window instead of the code animation. Any clip without a video keeps the code animation. If you only have time for a few, the game works with whatever subset arrives.

## 2. Gaps: what is still generated by code

### Art
| Gap | Where it shows | Suggested fix |
|---|---|---|
| Battle board pieces are plain circles (allies) and diamonds (enemies) with one character | Every battle | **Done in this build** where a painted figure exists: round head tokens cut from the figures (hero, 8 companions, bandits, leader, villager, masks, guild, Cangwu master). Other enemies keep the diamond. |
| 5 backgrounds are still code-drawn (`terraces_green` 6 scenes, `night_camp` 1, `penglai_cave` 3, `vault_stair` 2, `vault_hall` 5) | Some story scenes | **Done in this build** by borrowing a close painting (valley day, shrine night, cave night). Optional new art for `vault_hall` (an interior hall) and `night_camp` (campfire). |
| 2 NPCs have no figure: Isle Yun, the masked rider | A few scenes | 2 more full-body figures, same style (see `TIER2_ART_PLAN.md` for the block). |
| Other enemy types have no painting (gate scout and blade, sea raider, garrison sabre, etc.) | Battle tokens only | Optional: 6 to 8 more small NPC figures. Low priority, tokens only. |
| Fishing and tap minigames are drawn in code (pond, line, bars) | The fishing minigame | Optional: one painted pond background and a float and fish sprite. |
| The map is a list, not a map | The map screen | **Best remaining upgrade:** one painted parchment map of the province with the six regions (Jade Valley, Linjiang, Cangwu, the Marsh, Yanmen, Penglai). I can then place tappable markers on it. |
| No item, technique or manual icons | Inventory, arts | Optional: a set of about 12 small icons. Text works fine for now. |
| Hero full-body has no action poses (only the video clips above, and code bob and lean) | Dialogue, the main screen | Acceptable. |
| App icon and loading splash use the default engine look | Browser tab and loading screen | Two small images: a 512 px icon and a loading splash. |
